title: Juicy Quick French (Alsatian) Bread Croissant
description: Funky, juicy, kid-friendly French (Alsatian) dish featuring vegetable oil and a sweet glaze, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack. This recipe is anti-inflammatory-friendly and easy to make.
instructions: Activate yeast in warm milk for 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine yeast mixture, almond flour, granulated sugar, and salt.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Roll out the dough into a large rectangle.
Spread unsalted butter and honey evenly over the dough.
Roll the dough into a tight log and cut into 12 equal pieces.
Place the croissants on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving 1 inch of space between each croissant.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes before glazing.
Glaze with honey and serve warm.
